name: Sudan
value: UN: 1,630+ civilians killed by drones Jan–Oct
summary: Strikes hit West Kordofan villages near RSF-held Al Nuhud; Amnesty urges war-crimes inquiry into RSF El Obeid strikes
state: A Kordofan monitoring group said army strikes killed at least 17 civilians around Abu Qalb in West Kordofan in the week to 21 Nov and displaced about 3,000, and accused the RSF of killing three civilians nearby; the figures are unverified (Rio Times, 21 Nov). Amnesty International said on 18 Nov that nine RSF drone strikes on El Obeid from June to August killed 37 civilians (AllAfrica). A UN report on 18 Nov said drones killed more than 1,630 civilians from January to October (The National). Mass civilian deaths keep the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. People with family in Kordofan or Darfur can expect continued displacement and aid disruption; UN agencies publish updates on access and needs.
rubric_hit: Mass civilian deaths from drone and air strikes reported = Alert

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
